history.original_source: Changed pre-existing files matched the public f526 bytes before this batch; current same-profile test was then added for the before/after comparison.

preserved: Existing default Golden fixture, typed image service, UDS framing, startup/listener lifecycle, resource checks for those profiles and general observer hooks. No new IPC gateway or multiquery behavior.
remaining: Internal synchronous/async Fixed HTTP adapters, complete-response/Ray HTTP transport, configs, and dedicated tests still await removal.
ImageGateway shares mailbox/registration/lease/owner code with the old Map gateway; preserve those actual non-HTTP responsibilities while removing Map-specific branches and constants.
map_observation synthetic assembly still depends on the old builder; shared non-HTTP fixture data must move to the real consumer owner before retiring that assembly.
Native task/session values are separate from the unused HTTP native builder; no new model or IPC replacement is intended.
source_scope: Explicit fixed HTTP service options removed; Golden and typed Image UDS retained. Internal HTTP factories remain for the next deletion batch.
production_change: Remove the four dedicated HTTP CLI selections, config loaders/factory dispatch and unused remote_request_guard argument from server.py. The strict existing parse_args remains; retired options fail before selection and never silently choose Golden.
